info.title: r2f2 Account API
info.description: Browser uses HttpOnly cookies; App uses Supabase Bearer access token. All responses are private/no-store. Email is the login identifier; nicknames are display names only.

post.description: Signup may create a user. A verified existing email returns EMAIL_ALREADY_REGISTERED before sending mail; an unverified email may continue signup. Login never creates a user and does not disclose whether the address exists. Turnstile CAPTCHA is required.

parameters.name: X-Client-Type
parameters.description: App clients must set app. App protected operations require Bearer Token and ignore cookies.

parameters.name: Origin
parameters.description: Required and must equal APP_ORIGIN for browser write operations.

400.description: INVALID_INPUT / OTP_INVALID / AUTH_FAILED / CAPTCHA_REQUIRED / CAPTCHA_FAILED / WEBAUTHN_*
